result.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog.tsx, setIsInvalidEmail(false) is only called in the cancel button's onClick; onSuccess resets multiEmailValue and closes the dialog but never clears isInvalidEmail. The validation failure path sets setIsInvalidEmail(true) with no other reset, so the stale error banner persists across reopenings. Mechanism fully verifiable in the diff.

adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog`, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` on failed validation in `handleAdd`, but it is never cleared in the `addGuestsMutation.onSuccess` handler (which only closes the dialog and resets `multiEmailValue`). Since the dialog component stays mounted in `BookingListItem` and `onOpenChange={setIsOpenDialog}` does not reset state, reopening after a previous validation failure can show the red error banner over a reset/empty form. Only the explicit Cancel button clears `isInvalidEmail` (`setIsInvalidEmail(false)`), so closing via success or dialog close controls can leave the banner stuck.
